description: This file defines the MediaActivity class which manages media playback including audio, video, and images within the app. It handles UI setup, media controls, service binding for audio playback, and resource management for ExoPlayer instances.

classes.name: MediaActivity
classes.description: An activity responsible for managing media playback, including audio, video, and images. It handles UI updates, media controls, service interactions, and resource management for media players.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI, determines the type of attachment, and initializes media handling based on attachment type.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Handles video attachment initialization for SDK >= 24.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Handles video attachment initialization for SDK < 24 or when the player is null.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Pauses video playback and releases resources for SDK < 24.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Pauses video playback and releases resources for SDK >= 24.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves playback state for the video to restore later.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Releases media resources and unbinds services.

methods.name: setupToolbar
methods.description: Configures the activity's toolbar, including title and navigation icon color filter.

methods.name: bindToMusicService
methods.description: Binds to the music service, optionally starting it as a foreground service.

methods.name: collectMusicServiceFlow
methods.description: Collects updates from the music service to update UI controls and handle playback state.

methods.name: handleAudioAttachment
methods.description: Sets up UI for audio playback, binds to the music service, and loads album art.

methods.name: handleImageAttachment
methods.description: Displays image attachment and manages UI visibility toggle on tap.

methods.name: handleVideoAttachment
methods.description: Initializes ExoPlayer for video playback and manages UI controls.

methods.name: releaseExoPlayer
methods.description: Releases the ExoPlayer instance and saves playback state.
